reference_basis: Assistant-authored exploratory source references; no same-model SkillFlow comparator.

rules.observation: Direct audit and semantic-chain reconstruction satisfy paired source-reference assessment across repeated cases.
rules.interpretation: Direct prompting demonstrates replacement capability on this limited, explicit-contract case set. This experiment has not established an empirical advantage for SkillFlow. It does not establish universal replacement.

rules.observation: Audit fails but chain reconstruction passes on the same source.
rules.interpretation: Output organization can affect model accuracy; a source-only structured prompt remains a viable baseline. This is not evidence that programmatic SkillFlow is required.
A lightweight two-call alternative is supported for the reviewed first repeats. Do not extrapolate review success to the unreviewed repeats or erase original failures.

rules.observation: Substantive errors persist in both deliverables or vary across repeats.
rules.interpretation: Reliable replacement has not been demonstrated on those cases. This alone does not demonstrate SkillFlow superiority, because no same-model method comparison was run.

rules.observation: Reference or assessor disagreement remains material.
rules.interpretation: Retain an indeterminate result with source evidence, rather than forcing an accuracy point.
